title: Volatility-Clustering Adaptation for Financial Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2609.37715v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time-series foundation models are increasingly adapted to new domains through fine-tuning on target data, under the implicit assumption that more target data yields better forecasts. We show that this assumption can fail in financial forecasting, where individual price changes are difficult to predict, but large moves tend to cluster, creating alternating calm and turbulent periods. Using financial foundation models trained on price bars of open, high, low, close, and volume, we argue that adapting to financial domains requires training signals beyond next-token prediction. We introduce Volatility-Clustering Adaptation (VCA), which augments next-token cross-entropy with a differentiable penalty on the autocorrelation of squared returns, the standard statistical signature of volatility clustering. translated_title: 金融时间序列的波动率聚集自适应
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型越来越多地通过在目标数据上进行微调来适应新领域，其隐含的假设是：目标数据越多，预测效果越好。我们证明这一假设在金融预测中可能失效——在金融市场中，单个价格变化难以预测，但大幅波动往往会聚集出现，形成平静期与动荡期交替的现象。基于在由开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价和成交量构成的价格K线上训练的金融基础模型，我们认为要适应金融领域，需要超越下一词元预测的训练信号。我们提出波动率聚集自适应，在下一词元交叉熵损失之外，对平方收益率的自相关性——即波动率聚集的标准统计特征——施加可微惩罚项。这一额外目标通过将自回归展开所得的依赖结构与真实数据的依赖结构相匹配，提供了多步训练信号。
tldr: 提出波动率聚集自适应（VCA），通过在下一词元交叉熵之外对平方收益率自相关性施加可微惩罚，为金融基础模型提供捕捉波动率聚集现象的多步训练信号，弥补了“目标数据越多预测越好”这一微调假设在金融领域的失效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Volatility-Clustering Adaptation (VCA), which augments next-token cross-entropy with a differentiable penalty on the autocorrelation of squared returns, providing a multi-step training signal that captures volatility clustering and remedies the failure of the "more target data yields better forecasts" assumption when fine-tuning time-series foundation models for financial domains.
